target: AUDIT_2026-10-25 §A3: >=500 utterances from open data, WER and intent accuracy per slice
judge: sherpa-onnx whisper tiny.en (Whisper weights MIT, sherpa-onnx runtime Apache-2.0)

legs.wer: the open speakers' own words read by the pinned judge, per slice and per SNR - the set's acoustic difficulty, not our pipeline
legs.false_action_rate: the parser's share of the speakers' natural sentences it answered with a command - the M9 direction on open speech
legs.intent_accuracy: the service's OFFLINE brain (offline_brain, the dead-spot path) on the set's gold scripts; the address-bearing long forms have been its own since BUG-187's fix, and the server brain online answers the same sentences through its gateway
legs.intent_accuracy_with_slots: EVAL.md's M3 shape: the intent AND the comparable mandatory slots (`safe_place`, `reason`, `raw_address`, `minutes`, `kind`, `priority`) both correct

not_measured.M2_address_accuracy: the address is extracted on the device, not in the service (EVAL.md section 5)
not_measured.M4_wake_false_accepts: the non-speech corpus is continuous audio, not the utterance set
not_measured.M5_wake_misses: the wake word rates need the device
not_measured.M7_battery: the battery is measured on a device
not_measured.M8_tts_intelligibility: the synthesised audio needs the TTS voices, whose licence ledger check is pending
not_measured.M1_wer_on_our_pipeline: the product's own STT runs on the phone; the WER here is the set's open speakers read by the pinned judge
